description: The app's activity log, the last 90 days, newest first: who changed what and when — the developer from the panel, their team, and you through this MCP (via "mcp", which the panel shows as "from Claude"): settings, publishing, files, the team and who opens pre, products, the app's people, moderation, the back office screens. Lines { id, at, by (an email), who: owner | team | moderator, access? (the paper of a team member: partner | support | viewer | screens | staff), via: panel | mcp | app, area, action ("app.update", "file.upload", "user.ban"…), detail?, values?, target?, count? }: detail names what changed (the fields, the file, the email), never a secret's value; a settings change (app.update) also keeps in `values` ([{ field, value }]) the new value of the safe fields that really changed — numbers, switches and names such as "ai.tokensPerDay" → 20000, never keys, webhooks, Turnstile or prompts; the same change repeated within 10 minutes is one line with `count`. When the app keeps the moderation log (moderationLog), its moderators' acts come mixed in (who "moderator", via "app", action "mod.<kind>", by their user id and byName their name or email); moderation: false leaves them out. A page at a time: pass the answer's `next` as `before` (null: no more). Each line written costs the app's quota like a line of the moderation log.

before.description: The `next` of the previous page (or an ISO date: lines before it)

moderation.description: false: without the moderators' acts from the moderation log

via.description: Only lines from here: panel, mcp (you) or app (the moderators)

name: neblla_get_activity_log
title: Get activity log
